answer_1.quote: Text summarization is used to generate a concise and accurate summary of a long text ... The goal of dialogue summarization is to condense the conversational input into brief sentences ... We evaluate our new model on the popular SAM-Sum dialogue summarization dataset. Then, we extend our model to meeting summarization with the AMI Meeting Corpus.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate our model, we use three metrics: ROUGE : ROUGE measures Ngram overlap ... BARTScore : ... other automated metrics have been proposed to evaluate faithfulness more precisely. BARTScore is a transformer-based measure ...

answer_4.quote: Finally, we conduct human evaluations on 100 SAMSum and 20 AMI dialogues. ... We recruited seven volunteer participants ... Each evaluator is asked to examine ... and give a score on a scale from 1 to 10 for each of the criteria. We only consider faithfulness, instead of general quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated summary on a Likert scale from 1 to 10 for faithfulness and mark whether each error type from the taxonomy appears.
